comments.author: lolyu
comments.body:
The BGP running config for this looks correct to me(as `allowas-in` was assigned on the PG level)
```
 !
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  network 10.1.0.32/32
  neighbor TIER0_V4_DEPLOYMENT_ID_0 activate
  neighbor TIER0_V4_DEPLOYMENT_ID_0 soft-reconfiguration inbound
  neighbor TIER0_V4_DEPLOYMENT_ID_0 maximum-prefix 12000 90 warning-only
  neighbor TIER0_V4_DEPLOYMENT_ID_0 allowas-in 1
  neighbor TIER0_V4_DEPLOYMENT_ID_0 route-map FROM_TIER0_V4_DEPLOYMENT_ID_0 in
  neighbor TIER0_V4_DEPLOYMENT_ID_0 route-map TO_TIER0_V4 out
  neighbor TIER2_V4 activate
  neighbor TIER2_V4 soft-reconfiguration inbound
  neighbor TIER2_V4 maximum-prefix 12000 90 warning-only
  neighbor TIER2_V4 route-map FROM_TIER2_V4 in
  neighbor TIER2_V4 route-map TO_TIER2_V4 out
  maximum-paths 64
 exit-address-family
 !
 address-family ipv6 unicast
  network fc00:1::/64
  neighbor TIER0_V6_DEPLOYMENT_ID_0 activate
  neighbor TIER0_V6_DEPLOYMENT_ID_0 soft-reconfiguration inbound
  neighbor TIER0_V6_DEPLOYMENT_ID_0 maximum-prefix 8000 90 warning-only
  neighbor TIER0_V6_DEPLOYMENT_ID_0 allowas-in 1
  neighbor TIER0_V6_DEPLOYMENT_ID_0 route-map FROM_TIER0_V6_DEPLOYMENT_ID_0 in
  neighbor TIER0_V6_DEPLOYMENT_ID_0 route-map TO_TIER0_V6 out
  neighbor TIER2_V6 activate
  neighbor TIER2_V6 soft-reconfiguration inbound
  neighbor TIER2_V6 maximum-prefix 8000 90 warning-only
  neighbor TIER2_V6 route-map FROM_TIER2_V6 in
  neighbor TIER2_V6 route-map TO_TIER2_V6 out
  maximum-paths 64
 exit-address-family
!
```

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Improve the robustness of `test_bgp_bbr`

#### How did you do it?
Improve test_bgp_bbr:
1. for the route check on the first ToR that receives the update and
DUT, let's keep checking for a period of time to see if the route's
presence.
2. for the route check on the DUT, add extra check to verify the route
is advertised to the selected VMs.
